svg.text: Spectrum: block size and window of the FFT behind each point.
Live Orders: which orders to draw (Target Orders) and how wide a band around each (Order Width).
Tacho Tracking: Step, Sweep and Hysteresis decide where along the run-up a point is taken.
Options: Remove DC Offset and Overall Level + Residual.
Order curves: amplitude of each order against rpm, one curve per order.
Evaluation: Max, Top-N maxima, Typed orders or Dominant orders read off the curves.
